stories.title: Israël staat drie jaar na 7 oktober stil bij terreuraanval met herdenkingen en protest

en.title: Israel pauses three years after October 7 terror attack with commemorations and protests
en.summary: Israel marked the third anniversary of the October 7 terror attack through memorial events and public demonstrations.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor Scheikunde naar Fransman en Japanner

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Frenchman and Japanese
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to a French scientist and a Japanese scientist.

stories.title: Trump belt binnenkort met Poetin om te praten over de pest

en.title: Trump to call Putin soon to discuss plague
en.summary: US President Trump plans to call Russian President Putin regarding plague following an incident at a Russian research institute.

stories.title: Zeker vijftien doden bij zware Russische aanvallen op Oekraïne: 'Pijnlijke klap'

en.title: At least fifteen dead in heavy Russian attacks on Ukraine: 'Painful blow'
en.summary: Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least fifteen people overnight, including nine in a residential building in Prylutsk. President Zelensky stated Russian forces targeted energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Rente op studieleningen gaat voor kwart miljoen oud-studenten omhoog

en.title: Interest rates on student loans increase for quarter million former students
en.summary: Interest rates on student loans will rise next year for approximately 250,000 former students in the Netherlands. For those who took out loans before 2015, the increase will be nearly one percentage point.

stories.title: NSC verliest laatste volksvertegenwoordiger: Europarlementariër Dirk Gotink vertrekt vanwege toenadering die de partij zoekt tot Mona Keijzer

en.title: NSC loses final representative: MEP Dirk Gotink departs due to party's approach toward Mona Keijzer
en.summary: MEP Dirk Gotink has resigned from the NSC party, stating the party's political direction is not one he wishes to be part of. The departure leaves the party without any elected representatives.

stories.title: Laatste actieve NSC'er vertrekt, wil niet samenwerken met Mona Keijzer

en.title: Last active NSC member departs, unwilling to cooperate with Mona Keijzer
en.summary: MEP Dirk Gotink has resigned from NSC, citing disagreement with the party's openness to collaboration with Mona Keijzer's Project2029. This departure leaves the party without any elected representatives.

stories.title: Europarlementariër Gotink vertrekt bij NSC vanwege toenadering Mona Keijzer

en.title: MEP Gotink departs NSC over party's approach toward Mona Keijzer
en.summary: MEP Dirk Gotink has resigned from NSC due to the party's effort to establish ties with Mona Keijzer. He was the last serving representative of the party founded by Pieter Omtzigt in 2023.

stories.title: Christa Pike bij bewustzijn en aanspreekbaar na mislukte executiepoging. ‘Haar herstel is medisch gezien ongekend’

en.title: Christa Pike conscious and responsive after failed execution attempt. 'Her recovery is medically unprecedented'
en.summary: Christa Pike survived two lethal injections in Tennessee last week and was hospitalized. She would have been the first woman executed in the state in two hundred years.

stories.title: Ter dood veroordeelde Christa Pike bij bewustzijn en aanspreekbaar na mislukte executie

en.title: Death row inmate Christa Pike conscious and responsive after failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike remained conscious and able to communicate following a failed execution procedure in Tennessee.

stories.title: Christa Pike weer bij bewustzijn en aanspreekbaar na mislukte executie in VS

en.title: Christa Pike regains consciousness and is responsive after failed execution in US
en.summary: Christa Pike has regained consciousness following a failed execution attempt in the United States last week and is now responsive, according to her legal representatives.

stories.title: Franse scholieren zijn er klaar mee: 'Er is wel geld voor oorlog, niet voor ons'

en.title: French students have had enough: 'There is money for war, not for us'
en.summary: Tens of thousands of students, teachers, parents and union members demonstrated in Paris on Tuesday to protest education conditions, with police present in large numbers.
